method: Word onsets read BY EYE from wideband spectrograms (scripts/phase2_align_report.py, 640 px per second, 12 ms window) and written down before looking at any statistics. Marked by the AI assistant, not by a human listener: nothing was heard. Reading uncertainty is about +/-25 ms (e.g. whether a stop's closure belongs to the word). Only onsets that were visible are included; 18 of the 28 words.
